cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Start the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to explain, announce, or begin the emotionally difficult part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You tell the choir the tour's cancelled. I'll get the refund forms ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're the organiser. I'm not standing up there alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stand beside you. You make the announcement; I'll handle the refunds.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They'll want to know why we're cancelling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with 'we lost the funding'. I'll take the questions once you've said that.

reason: Give A a concrete presence concession and later-question responsibility to secure B announcement; keep emotional-first-sentence avoidance without detached status or hierarchy.
